title: 50bb · Turn · Weighted ranges
description: A complete turn-to-river game on Qs 9h 6c 2d with a 32bb pot and 34bb behind. This variant uses explicit mixed hand-class inclusion weights rather than equal combination weights. Every legal river and both streets' modeled actions are solved together.
rangeAssumptions: Illustrative weighted starting ranges with 30 BTN and 27 BB unblocked exact combinations. The class multipliers below apply per exact combination before normalization and joint card removal; they are not action frequencies. These ranges were chosen for study, not certified from a solved preflop or flop line. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
